summary: Frontend and backend verification complete for MyGenie POS app cloned from GitHub. Login page loads successfully with all expected UI elements. Backend API responds correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend uses REACT_APP_API_BASE_URL and REACT_APP_SOCKET_URL from .env - currently set to preview URL as placeholder
Backend is the default Emergent scaffold (not the actual MyGenie backend) - only provides /api/ health check
Login page has proper data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
ESLint warnings present but no blocking errors - all are react-hooks/exhaustive-deps warnings
test_credentials: No test credentials available - this is a frontend-only deployment that requires external MyGenie backend
context_for_next_testing_agent: App cloned from GitHub repo. Frontend loads correctly at preview URL. Backend is placeholder scaffold. User needs to provide actual MyGenie backend API URL for full functionality. Login will fail without real backend.
